United Arab Emirates: UAE Net Zero by 2050 Strategic Initiative: the national target that sets the direction for industry and product decarbonisation.
Federal Decree-Law No. 11 of 2024 on reducing the effects of climate change: requires companies, including those in free zones, to measure and report their emissions.
Single-use plastics phase-out (Ministerial Resolution No. 380 of 2022): bags banned from 2024, with cups, cutlery, containers and similar items from 2026.
Federal Law No. 12 of 2018 on integrated waste management: covers how waste is reduced, handled, recycled and disposed of.
European Union: European Green Deal and European Climate Law: climate neutrality by 2050 and at least a 55% cut in net emissions by 2030.
Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (EU) 2024/1781: durability, repairability and recycled-content rules, plus a Digital Product Passport for covered product groups.
Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (EU) 2025/40: recyclability and recycled-content requirements for packaging sold in the EU.
Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (EU) 2023/956: a carbon cost on imports of goods such as iron, steel, aluminium and cement.
International: ISO 14040 and ISO 14044: the standard method for carrying out a life cycle assessment.
ISO 14067: how to quantify and report a product's carbon footprint.
ISO 14001: requirements for an environmental management system in a company.
GHG Protocol Product Standard: a widely used method for measuring a product's greenhouse-gas emissions.
